title: Numerical tables posted in the NeurIPS 2026 OpenReview rebuttal
transcription_status: Transcribed from exact numerical rows supplied by the parent agent from its prior live CUA observation. The writing agent did not independently re-fetch OpenReview. Typography and mathematical notation are normalized to plain text; numeric strings retain the supplied precision.
evidence_status: Posted author claims, not independently validated experiment results.

cell_conventions.numeric_strings: Values are strings to preserve displayed precision and percent or ratio notation; they are not recalculated.
cell_conventions.null: No value was supplied in the captured row. This does not mean zero, failed, or not applicable unless separately stated.
cell_conventions.dash: The incomplete Medical EM steering row was reported with dashes. ASCII '-' preserves that missing-value distinction without claiming the original dash glyph.
cell_conventions.slash_separated_seeds: Seed values remain in the posted order 1/2/42; no seed averaging is performed.

known_source_protocol_ambiguities: The seed table does not print a metric or feature budget for every task. Those missing details are not inferred here.
The Stacked comparison labels backtracking detection PR-AUC(S8), while the T-SAE width and percentage tables label PR-AUC S32. These labels and values are preserved without reconciliation.
The seed table gives backtracking .27/.27/.26; the window table gives headline .26 and other tables use .27. No choice of seed, averaging rule, or architecture variant is inferred.

The parent capture describes the final percentage table as a headline comparison relative to SAE performance, but does not supply the exact normalization formula for each row. Sparse probing is separately labeled AUC-deficit reduction.
The T-SAE width table prints the same d18432 width in both HH-RLHF columns. This is preserved as posted.
The parameter table prints TFA(T5) and MLC(L5); the GFLOPs table does not print these suffixes in the supplied architecture cells. No unprinted batch size or token throughput is inferred.

These posted tables alone do not establish the run IDs, checkpoint identities, training seeds for all cells, evaluation splits, uncertainty estimates, exact compute formula, or reproducibility of the claims.
